blocks.text: A304 20838 78B AVENUE Willoughby Heights Langley V2Y 3M1

parts.t: Welcome to Hudson & Singer, located in the heart of Willoughby Heights! This unit, featuring 2 bedrooms & 2 bathrooms comes equipped with under-mount sinks, soft-close cabinets, stylish matte fixtures, Silestone quartz counters, vinyl plank flooring, and 9-ft ceilings. Enjoy the outdoor amenities, including BBQ areas, picnic tables, a putting green, and a playground. Just a short walk from the Willoughby Town Centre, you'll find coffee shops, grocery stores, restaurants, and more. This property is perfect for first-time buyers looking to enter the market or savvy investors seeking a solid opportunity. Both Willoughby Elementary and Richard Bulpitt Elementary are conveniently within walking distance.
